tagline: A leading digital marketplace for wholesale used vehicles
hero_kpi_rationale: GMV is the hero KPI as it directly measures the economic volume circulating on the digital platform, reflecting the health and adoption of its online marketplace model, the core of its tech value.

kpis.name: Gross merchandise value
kpis.explanation: Total value of vehicles sold on the platform in one year.
kpis.description: GMV of $28.8 billion in 2025 illustrates the scale of the digital market that OPENLANE operates, connecting buyers and sellers of used vehicles.
kpis.signal: WOW: Digital platform with GMV of $28.8 billion in 2025

kpis.name: Annual transaction count
kpis.explanation: Total number of vehicles sold via the platform each year.
kpis.description: With approximately 1.5 million annual transactions, OPENLANE demonstrates strong adoption of its digital model in the automotive resale sector.
kpis.signal: WOW: 1.5 million annual transactions on the platform

kpis.name: Total headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working in the company.
kpis.description: Headcount of 3,200 employees supports the company's technology, logistics, and financial operations.

kpis.name: Marketplace segment revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated by digital marketplace activities.
kpis.description: The Marketplace segment is one of the company's two pillars, generating revenue through digital transactions and ancillary services.
kpis.signal: Primary segment generating $1.2 billion in revenue

kpis.name: Finance segment revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenues from financing services to dealers.
kpis.description: The Finance segment (AFC) complements the ecosystem with floorplan and title services, supporting transactions on the platform.
kpis.signal: Complementary segment generating $0.4 billion in revenue

kpis.name: Capital expenditures
kpis.explanation: Capital spending to improve technology infrastructure.
kpis.description: Capex investments are being made to modernize IT systems, notably migration to an enterprise ERP and consolidation of technology platforms.

kpis.name: Total assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €4.72 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Total debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €0.59 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Anticipated off-lease vehicle volume
kpis.explanation: Growing number of off-lease vehicles expected starting in 2026 in the automotive remarking industry.
kpis.description: Starting in 2026, a significant increase in off-lease vehicle volume is expected to strengthen platform activity, with the majority of volume flowing through OPENLANE.
kpis.signal: Future growth expected from off-lease vehicles

kpis.name: Digital transformation progress
kpis.explanation: Advancement of key IT projects such as platform consolidation and ERP migration.
kpis.description: Digital transformation, including ERP migration and technology platform consolidation, is a long-term strategic lever to improve operational efficiency.
kpis.signal: Digital transformation underway over multiple years

risks.title: Cyberattacks and data security
risks.score_rationale: Risk cited as top risk factor with detailed governance framework (CISO, Audit Committee). Language emphasizes continuous monitoring and emerging threats. Cybersecurity category is critical for a technology company. Central position in 10-K.

risks.title: Economic conditions dependency
risks.score_rationale: Repeated mention of impact from interest rates, inflation, tariffs, and consumer confidence. Strong language: 'material impact'. Linked to vehicle demand and financing. Central macroeconomic risk for the model. High position in the text.

risks.title: Vehicle price volatility
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly linked to credit losses at AFC. Text mentions 'volatility' and 'severity of losses'. Direct impact on collateral value. Credit category heavily weighted here. Mentioned across multiple sections.

risks.title: Increased market competition
risks.score_rationale: Text mentions competition from franchised and public dealers in the used vehicle market. Direct threat to AFC's independent dealer customer base. Implicit language but clear strategic context. Structural risk to growth.

risks.title: Off-lease vehicle supply dependency
risks.score_rationale: Text emphasizes expectation of increase in off-lease vehicles starting in 2026. Any changes (e.g. pricing) could reduce supply. Key supply risk for the marketplace. Forward-looking language with uncertainty.

risks.title: Pending litigation
risks.score_rationale: Mention of lawsuits in ordinary course of business. Management estimates no material impact expected. Reassuring language but risk remains present. Secondary position in the document.

ai_positioning.summary: OPLN does not mention artificial intelligence in its 10-K/20-F report.
